title: BAE Systems Pension Schemes Trustees Appoint Goldman Sachs Asset Management for Approximately £23 Billion UK Pension Schemes Mandate
note: Primary source for the BAE Systems OCIO mandate: ~£23bn UK DB assets, 'largest OCIO mandate awarded to date in the UK Market' (GS's own claim), in-house team joins GSAM, transition expected towards end 2023. GS self-description as 'second largest OCIO manager globally'; OCIO AUS 'more than £200 billion' and firm AUS as of 30 June 2023. Names Ed Francis as Head of International OCIO and UK Fiduciary Management Team.

title: BAE Systems' pension schemes award GSAM £23bn OCIO mandate
note: Adds advisers not in the GS release: Redington (trustees' strategic investment adviser since 2021, continuing to oversee implementation) and Travers Smith for trustees; PwC for sponsor. 185,000 members. Re-reports the press release, so not independent corroboration of GS's 'largest' claim.

title: Goldman's OCIO Scores a Massive Pension Mandate — And Another Liftout
note: History of GS OCIO growth by acquisition and liftout: Pacific Global Advisors (2015), Verus OCIO business (2017), Aptitude (2018), Bombardier team (2022), BAE (2023). Quotes Tim Braude (global co-head of multi-asset solutions and global head of OCIO, as at Sept 2023).

title: GSAM appointed by Shell to run £29bn global OCIO pension scheme brief
note: Shell OCIO mandate: $40bn (£29bn) across pension entities and a captive insurer; ~£11.5bn UK; advisory for North America; tender overseen by Isio; transitions expected later in 2025; GSAM OCIO AUS 'nearly $450bn'. Quotes Marc Nachmann and Chloe Kipling ('co-head of EMEA institutional client coverage').

title: Shell pension funds award OCIO mandate to GSAM
note: Same announcement; gives UK $15.6bn and Germany $2.8bn. No mention of any in-house staff transfer. Notes Shell's Dutch fund appointed BlackRock in 2024.

title: Shell to Outsource $40B in European Pension Assets to Goldman Sachs
note: Describes GS as 'fiduciary manager' for UK ($15.6bn) and Germany ($2.8bn); compares with a $43.4bn UPS mandate 'the prior year' (US). GS AUS $3.3tn incl. nearly $450bn OCIO at that date.

title: OCIO becoming strategic choice for UK schemes
note: Interview with Chloe Kipling ('co-head of EMEA institutional business at GSAM'). OCIO business 'oversees more than £300bn globally'; multi-asset solutions team 'over 300 people'; range from fully delegated fiduciary to hybrid models; hire of Carolyn Schuster-Woldan as MD in UK fiduciary management/OCIO team in September 2025.

title: Choosing an External Investment Manager (OCIO vs fiduciary management)
publisher: Goldman Sachs Asset Management (insight article by Ed Francis)
note: GSAM's own definitions: OCIO = partial delegation (trustees keep strategy/SAA, usually with third-party advice); fiduciary management = fuller delegation incl. strategy advice. Says terms are used interchangeably and differ by geography. Cites Isio 2023: ~18% of UK schemes use some form of fiduciary management.

title: Goldman Sachs Asset Management Secures $70 Billion in Retirement Asset Mandates (Verizon, Lockheed Martin)
note: US OCIO mandates: $30bn DB OCIO AUM (Verizon, Lockheed Martin) and $40bn DC assets under advisement (Verizon). '$480 billion in OCIO assets under supervision (AUS) globally as of 3/31/2026'; firm AUS ~$3.7tn at 31 March 2026. Shows OCIO is a global business, not UK-only.

title: European Pensions Fiduciary Management / OCIO Award 2026
note: Award presented 2 July 2026 by European Pensions; judged by a panel; attention to activity over prior 12–18 months; 'No compensation was paid'. Ed Francis quoted as 'Global Co-Head of the Outsourced Chief Investment Officer business'; growth cited in UK, Netherlands, Germany, Switzerland. Self-published page about a third-party award.

title: Irish Pensions Awards 2026: Fiduciary Management / OCIO of the Year
note: Award presented 4 November 2026 at the Irish Pensions Awards (created/tabulated by European Pensions). Christy Jesudasan quoted as 'Managing Director, Head of EMEA OCIO Institutional Business'. Search results show this page circulated with a '?ls=linkedin' tracking parameter.

title: Pensions Age Fiduciary Management Firm of the Year Award 2024
note: UK award (Pensions Age Awards 2024). Nine nominations in category; criteria: excellence, innovation, commitment to pension fund clients, dedication to UK pension provision; focus on prior 12 months. '2023 was a monumental year for our UK Fiduciary Management OCIO business'.

title: Pensions Age LDI Manager of the Year Award 2026
note: Presented 3 March 2026. LDI (not OCIO) award. Simon Bentley quoted as Head of UK LDI and CDI. Five nominations in category; period judged Jan–Dec 2025; no compensation paid.

title: UK Pensions Awards 2026 — The Winners
note: Awards presented 11 June 2026. Fiduciary Manager of the Year went to Van Lanschot Kempen, not GSAM. GSAM won ESG Manager of the Year.

title: Goldman Sachs appointed as fiduciary manager for two UK pension schemes
note: Short Brothers Common Investment Fund: two schemes, £1.6bn combined; competitive tender supported by PwC; strategies run by both internal and external managers; bespoke hedging. Ed Francis titled MD and head of UK fiduciary management.

title: GSAM names MD for UK fiduciary management business
note: Ed Francis joined from Willis Towers Watson (20 years; six as head of investment EMEA) to lead UK fiduciary management. Chloe Kipling then 'head of GSAM UK and Ireland Institutional Business'. Historical titles only.

title: Jaguar Pension Plan: Annual Report and Financial Statements, year ended 31 March 2025

title: Briefing note: The Pension Schemes Act 2026
note: Royal Assent 29 April 2026. DC scale: £25bn by 2030 or on track by 2035, not in force before 1 Jan 2030. Reserve asset-allocation power usable 1 Jan 2028–31 Dec 2032, sunset end 2035. DB surplus release: consultation 2026, regulations 2027. Superfunds, Virgin Media remedy, VFM, small pots, guided retirement, LGPS. Consultant's summary of the Act and DWP roadmap, not the statute text.

title: LGPS Fit for the Future: pooling and governance regulations laid
note: Law-firm summary: LGPS Pooling Regulations and Governance Regulations 2026 in force 30 June 2026; administering authorities must delegate implementation of investment strategy to their pool and take principal investment advice from it; ISS deadline 31 March 2027; pool companies to be full-scope UK AIFM / MiFID firms by 30 Sept 2027; Secretary of State backstop direction powers.

title: LGPS pools onboard new partner funds as 'Fit for the Future' rules come into effect
note: Pools reduced from eight to six; Brunel and ACCESS told their plans did not meet government's vision; funds moving to LGPS Central and LPPI etc. from 1 April 2026.

title: Pension schemes back British growth (Mansion House Accord)
note: 17 workplace pension providers; voluntary; 10% of DC default funds in private markets by 2030, at least 5% in the UK; 'up to £50 billion', ~£25bn UK; signatories manage ~90% of active savers' DC pensions.

title: Tender for fiduciary management services (detailed guidance)
note: Legal duty (Occupational Pension Schemes (Scheme Administration) Regulations 1996 as amended, from 1 Oct 2022, replacing the CMA Order 2019): qualifying tender before FM providers manage 20% or more of manageable assets; invite bids from at least three unconnected providers. Good practice: third-party evaluator, scorecards, GIPS performance.

title: Fiduciary mandate numbers decline as endgame focus intensifies (Isio Fiduciary Management Survey 2025)
note: UK DB fiduciary market: £241bn (2025) vs £242bn (2024); 832 mandates vs 865 (−4%), first decline since 2008; 60+ new mandates in 12 months to 30 June 2025; OCIO arrangements 53% of fiduciary assets. Page shows no exact publication date. No provider-level shares.

title: UK fiduciary management AUM hits £272bn as mandate sizes grow
note: Search-result summary only: Quantum Advisory dashboard put UK FM AUM at £272bn (up from £255bn the prior quarter), average mandate £404m; schemes >£1bn are ~4% of appointments but ~two-thirds of assets. Different methodology from Isio; not directly comparable. Date not confirmed (2026).

title: Bulk annuity and longevity hedging – H2 2025

title: PPF7800 index surplus falls by £5.3bn in October
